meta.what: Every quantitative claim published by the six pre-existing dashboards, with an independent recheck. Claims that could not be checked against an official source are marked UNVERIFIED and left blank.
meta.method: Recomputed from the repository artefact named in each row. No value here was copied from a dashboard without recomputation.

statuses.VERIFIED: Recomputed from the artefact and, where an official source exists, checked against it.
statuses.DISCREPANCY: The dashboard value does not agree with a recomputation from its own underlying artefact.
statuses.UNVERIFIED: No official source is available to confirm the value. Left blank rather than estimated.

claims.claim: 174 games captured, 20 Oct - 12 Nov 2026
claims.check: Counted rows in data/origin/games.csv after the header: 174 data rows, 0 duplicates by date+teams.

claims.claim: 348 team-games, zero discrepancy against the official games-played column
claims.check: 174 games x 2 = 348 team-games. Consistency of the games-played column is a claim about a page not held in the repository, so it is checked only for arithmetic here.

claims.claim: Margin model RMSE 16.18 vs 17.30 baseline (walk-forward, 114 out-of-sample games)
claims.check: Recomputed from the 114 rows in oos_games using the model the dashboard says it selected (predC_margin): RMSE 16.1786, reproducing the published 16.18. The unblended model A alone gives 16.65, so the blend is what is being reported.

claims.claim: Total model RMSE 20.35, worse than the 19.56 baseline
claims.check: Recomputed on the selected total model (totalT2, a Massey least-squares model): RMSE 20.3459, reproducing the published 20.35. The baseline reproduces at 19.5605, so the dashboard correctly reports its own total model as losing to the baseline.

claims.claim: 0 of 8 strategies pass all 7 gates
claims.check: Counted strategies where passed_all_gates is true: 0. Every strategy fails the 100-bet sample floor.

claims.claim: Strategy S5 (fade totals 235+) wins 21 of 24
claims.check: Read wins and n from the strategy record; 21/24 = 0.875. Under the stated null of 0.5, exact binomial p = 0.00028.

claims.claim: Spread/total residual correlation r = +0.091, 95% CI [-0.09, +0.27]
claims.check: Recomputed Pearson r on the two residual series in oos_games: r = +0.0790. This is a close but not identical reproduction; the dashboard uses its own residual definition. The interval includes zero either way.

claims.claim: Walk-forward backtest, burn-in 30, 138 test games of 174
claims.check: First read as inconsistent because 30 + 138 = 168, not 174. Recomputed and the claim is correct: the walk-forward file has 36 rows without a fitted calibration (indices 0-35), because the logistic fit needs 30 calibration games and then fails to converge for a further 6. Rows with a fitted calibration and index >= 30 number exactly 138. A false-alarm check was retained here deliberately as evidence that recomputation, not inspection, is what settles these claims.

claims.claim: STRAT1 ROI +48.24% at an assumed -110 over 85 bets
claims.check: Recomputed from the 85 rows in backtest_bets.json: 66 wins, 19 losses. At -110 a win returns 0.9091 units, so 66 x 0.9091 - 19 = 41.00 units over 85 bets = +48.24%. Reproduces exactly.

claims.claim: STRAT1 is a spread strategy
claims.check: The recorded settlement rule is `won = (margin > 0) if side == HOME else (margin < 0)`. That settles on who wins the game, not on covering a spread. It is a moneyline rule. The published 77.6% win rate is consistent with a moneyline, not a spread, at that implied probability. See contradiction C-03.

claims.claim: STRAT1 and STRAT2 are profitable after an assumed -110 price
claims.check: Arithmetic reproduces. The economic claim does not: the bets settle on the moneyline, where -110 is not a price that is offered. Recorded model probabilities imply fair prices near -332 and +105. The profit figure is therefore measured against a price that could not have been obtained.

claims.claim: Parlay example: 0.58 x 0.58 legs at rho = 0.3 gives joint 0.58, fair price 1.72
claims.check: The published figure is wrong. The joint probability of two 0.58 legs cannot reach 0.58 unless the legs are perfectly correlated; 0.58 is the Frechet upper bound. Two independent numerical methods (adaptive Simpson integration and 200,000-draw Monte Carlo) both give 0.3832 at rho = +0.3, implying fair odds 2.61 rather than 1.72. The cause is a code defect: the integration loop covers the whole real line and never uses the first-leg threshold. See contradiction C-02.

claims.claim: Same-game margin/total correlation -0.018
claims.check: Recomputed Pearson r between margin and total on the walk-forward test set. Signed value depends on which test set is used; magnitude is near zero in every version. Cannot be confirmed from an official source because it is a model-internal statistic.

claims.claim: Brier score 0.2001
claims.check: Recomputed mean squared error of p_home against the home-win indicator on the reported test set. Reproduces.

claims.claim: Spread + total legs are close to independent, so a spread+total parlay can be multiplied with little error
claims.check: Direction of the measured correlation is consistent with the other pipelines. The operational advice is not: on the 114 out-of-sample games the same-game cover-and-over joint rate is 0.2719 against an independent product of 0.2526, a 7.65% relative error. Multiplying is acceptable only as a first approximation, and the dashboard's wording overstates it.

claims.claim: In-sample backtest: Brier 0.1528, accuracy 0.8488
claims.check: The dashboard itself labels this in-sample and says it overstates any edge. Correctly disclosed, so it is not an irregularity, but it is not a performance claim either.

claims.claim: No strategy is eligible for staking
claims.check: Read all leaderboard rows: every eligible flag is false. Consistent with /origin/ and /edge/.

claims.claim: 117 injury rows from the official 11/13/26 5:00 PM report
claims.check: Counted rows in data/injuries.json: 117. Of these, 110 are named players and 7 are team-level NOT YET SUBMITTED placeholders. All 110 named players were checked against the official PDF with 0 status mismatches.

claims.claim: The 5:00 PM report is the current injury snapshot
claims.check: A 7:30 PM report for the same date is published at the official index and was available before the 5:00 PM snapshot was committed. Between the two, 11 players changed status, including Klay Thompson Probable to Out and Pelle Larsson Doubtful to Out. See contradiction C-05.

claims.claim: 31 games, 13-16 Nov 2026, verified against nba.com/schedule
claims.check: Registered as the slate size in the research dataset. The official schedule PDF is labelled 'subject to change', so the count is a snapshot, not a guarantee.

claims.claim: Picks, lines and correlation values are deliberately blank (flags F13, F14, F21)
claims.check: Read the site: no numeric picks or lines are published. This is consistent, but it means four other dashboards publish picks that this dashboard does not. That disagreement is itself a contradiction (C-08).

claims.claim: 77 injury rows from the 11/11/26 5:00 PM report
claims.check: The docs site uses a snapshot two days older than the others. Not wrong, but it must not be compared with the 11/13 sites. See C-05.

claims.claim: Player-level correlations (points-points, points-rebounds, points-assists)
claims.check: Left blank by the pipeline. Confirmed blank in model_output.json. It cannot be computed without per-player game logs, which are not in the repository.

claims.claim: 22 originated lines for 2026-11-14 to 2026-11-16
claims.check: Counted rows: 22 games. The official NBA.com schedule shows 5 games on Nov 14, 7 on Nov 15 and more on Nov 16; the 22 rows are internally consistent with the slate the pipeline was given, but the slate was not re-pulled on the verification date (V-F-10).

claims.claim: Every pick card's printed spread names the same favourite as its own moneyline
claims.check: All 22 cards re-checked after the fix in pipeline/make_picks.py. The favourite now carries the minus sign and the named team matches the model favourite on every card. Before the fix, 0 of 22 were correct: the generator printed the away team with a plus handicap regardless of which side was favoured. See contradiction C-01 and correction FX-02.

claims.claim: Total model RMSE 19.27
claims.check: Recomputed from the walk-forward detail file for rows where a total prediction exists.

claims.claim: Home court advantage value
claims.check: The pipelines fit different home-advantage values on the same games (+1.59 and one Elo-based figure) and none is checked against an official league statistic. League-wide home-court advantage is not published as a single official number, so this is left blank and flagged.
